description: This file contains unit tests for EventHub subscription multiplicity scenarios in an Orleans streaming environment. It defines a test class with multiple test methods to verify parallel, linear, add/remove, resubscription, and intermittent stream behaviors, along with a fixture class to configure the test cluster.
